signal_basis.exact_text: The focal and comparison drafts use the same archive handling-ledger template.

Panel A has a continuous reliable ledger and witnessed attachments placing its identified opening-section assembly before its dated binding event. Panel B has a continuous reliable ledger and witnessed attachments placing its identified closing-section replacement after its dated editorial review.
Ledger-template identity is the only stated cross-draft connection; shared authorship, leaf identity and assembly dates are not stipulated.
